Jari Jukka Laru, KT

Municipal politician

Second-term city councillor in Oulu (National Coalition Party). Involved in civic influence since high school.

Politics →

University lecturer

Lecturer in technology-enhanced learning at the Faculty of Education, University of Oulu.

Work →

Trainer & speaker

Expert lectures and training in AI literacy, learning technology, and modern pedagogy.

Training & talks →

Father & husband

Lives with family in Jääli, Oulu. Bibliophile, food enthusiast, road-tripper, and renovator of a 1970s house.

About me →

Civic Impact

Politics and decision-making

I work as a second-term city councillor in Oulu (National Coalition Party), with a long-term focus on practical, evidence-informed local policy.
